fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM86,810. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0054119/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: Credit in Bahasa Malaysia II at SPM level; THREE (3) C’s at STPM level including Pengajian Am (General Studies) or TWO (2) C’s including Pengajian Am (General Studies) plus TWO (2) D’s; OR THREE (3) A-levels; OR an MSU Foundation Certificate; OR MSU/PTPL Diploma; OR an equivalent qualification recognized by MSU Senate.
